description:
We are a motivated team of developers and problem-solvers with experience in hackathons, web development, backend systems, databases, AI-assisted development, and project presentation. We enjoy turning complex problems into practical and visually engaging solutions.

We are looking for teammates with strong skills in data science, GIS/geospatial technologies, remote sensing, AI/ML, or scientific research — especially people interested in Earth observation and NASA missions.
summary: Finding comparable radar observations and interpreting changes across dates can be difficult without geospatial tools. NISAR Lens makes NASA–ISRO NISAR observations explorable in a browser, with catalog search, repeat-pass comparison on a 3D globe, and a worked example of possible changes in surface water.
details: 1. Find a radar observation. Select Meghna Baseline, set Product to GCOV, and click Open selected image. The catalog shows where each acquisition was taken. Metadata and SAR Browse show product details and the available previews. Search NASA ASF loads observations for a latitude and longitude.
